emailStates.meaning: Approved; worker has not yet completed submission.
Provider accepted the message; this is not evidence of inbox delivery.
Confirmed rejected attempt, with reason and retry eligibility.
Uncertain provider result. Reconcile before a new attempt to avoid duplicates.

steps: Review interpolated email for each language and recipient variant
requirements: One email per recipient; never expose a cohort via To or CC.
Show exact recipients and excluded users with reasons before approval; revalidate permissions and recipient eligibility at dispatch.
Template edits in composer modify the draft; saving a shared template is a separate explicit action.
Freeze the approved text, recipient list, template version, variables and language as the send snapshot.
Block approval while subject/body, recipient address or required variables are missing.
Use a durable per-recipient operation key; repeating approval or retry never duplicates a successful send.
Show provider acceptance as Sent. Delivery, bounce and open labels may appear only with verified provider events; omit invented rates.
For batch partial failures, allow retry only for eligible failed recipients; never re-send successful recipients.
Unknown results need provider reconciliation or verified idempotent retry; the user is not asked to guess whether an email was sent.
Keep email sender configuration and real provider setup as future implementation dependencies. No design sample sends real emails.

templateInventory.freeform: A blank editable email remains available. A start reminder uses a freeform draft based on welcome; it does not need a separate default template.

commonVariables.first_name: Recipient given name when available, otherwise a localized friendly greeting; always resolved before preview.
commonVariables.app_link: Owner-approved public application URL. Replace with a verified invitation URL only when a supported invitation flow exists; never fabricate an authentication token.
commonVariables.account_email: Current approved recipient account email, isolated LTR.
commonVariables.conversation_link: Authorized link to the recipient's own conversation or Feedback & help entry point, depending on context.
commonVariables.pilot_end_date: Real end of the recipient's pilot period, formatted in the email locale with a timezone when needed.

welcome.trigger: A real user is accepted into the pilot and has no successful welcome-send record for that pilot.
welcome.manualAndBatch: The same task is visible from Overview and the user detail. Batch review can include all eligible users.
welcome.completion: Close the task after a provider-accepted welcome email, whether started manually or from the task. Queued and failed attempts remain linked to the open task; do not offer duplicate composition while queued.
welcome.existingRecord: Do not infer that welcome was sent from account age. A verified historical send may be recorded separately with evidence and audit reason.
welcome.failure: Restore Needs attention with a clear failure reason. A later confirmed bounce may create a distinct contact-correction task.

feedback.trigger: Successfully stored learner question or feedback.
feedback.completion: A reply is published to the same thread only after admin approval. Close the conversation explicitly or after the admin-selected resolution; a new learner reply reopens it.
feedback.noAutomation: Suggested responses and routine thanks are drafts. They are never sent automatically.

requirements: Claim Message received only after server persistence, not when a local draft is saved.
Use durable request IDs so repeat taps and retry do not create duplicate conversations or messages.
Show submission failure inline; preserve draft. Do not promise an unapproved response-time SLA.
The app thread is the durable reply surface. Honor the recorded email-notification preference. A notification failure does not erase the published approved reply; its failure is an admin action.
Keep basic diagnostic context opt-in and visible; no automatic class content, recordings or unrelated account data in the support message.
Attachments and automated replies are outside the initial design scope.
Suggested admin responses use this conversation and verified knowledge; unresolved facts remain visibly marked for admin completion.

screenInventory.purpose: Priority actions, welcome task, messages needing reply, cost and processing context.
Search/filter, single user action and selected-recipient toolbar.
Pilot status, allowance, communication preference and send history.
Editable template, subject/body, email language and recipient list.
Personalized recipient previews, unresolved-variable errors and approval.
New/Needs reply/Answered/Closed tabs with readable excerpts.
Conversation timeline, suggested reply, edit, approve and close.
Nine default templates, language variants, a freeform draft and explicitly saved versions.
Question/feedback/problem form, opt-in basic context and saved-draft/error state.
Own message history with reply state and new-message action.
Own conversation, approved admin reply and user follow-up.
